CustomField.description: Calculates the Total Final Monthly Fees
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISPICKVAL( SBQQ__SubscriptionType__c ,'Renewable'),ISPICKVAL( SBQQ__SubscriptionType__c ,'Evergreen')) , ( IF(NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c > 0, NSP_Quoted_Quantity__c,SBQQ__Quantity__c) * SBQQ__NetPrice__c) ,0)
CustomField.label: Total Final Monthly Fees
